priorityList: Maintain Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, and Lightning Shield at all times.
Cast Voltaic Blaze or Flame Shock if the target does not have Flame Shock ticking.
Activate Ascendance when Thorim's Invocation is ready to trigger Chain Lightning.
Cast Sundering if Whirling Earth is active or the Surging Elements talent is taken.
Cast Lava Lash if Whirling Fire is active or if Hot Hand is procced.
Cast Crash Lightning if Whirling Air is active while Doom Winds or Ascendance is up.
Cast Tempest or Primordial Storm when at 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
Cast Chain Lightning when at 9 or more Maelstrom Weapon stacks (or 10 with Surging Totem active).
Cast Voltaic Blaze whenever it becomes available.
Cast Crash Lightning to maintain its cleave buff and trigger Thorim's Invocation.
Cast Sundering if Surging Totem has more than 25 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Use Stormstrike and Lava Lash as filler when higher priority abilities are unavailable.
Cast Chain Lightning to spend Maelstrom if you have 5 or more stacks and nothing else to press.
